messages:
nina: FYI — Casey submitted a resignation, last day Friday 2026-06-04. We need a tight runbook for access deprovision, benefits cutoff (COBRA opt-in window), and hardware return. Can folks own pieces?

omar: I can own SSO + cloud creds. I'll need the exact list of service accounts and personal SSH keys tied to Casey's accounts.

leah: I'll handle security tokens and VPN blockers. Please make sure we have any allowed exceptions documented.

nina: Thanks. Quick checklist draft below — please edit: 
• create offboard ticket in IT (assign Omar)
• schedule exit interview (People Ops)
• disable SSO, remove group memberships (Omar)
• revoke service account keys and personal PATs (Leah)
• block VPN and rotate shared secrets (Leah)
• confirm laptop serial + create UPS/shipping label (Nina)
• benefits end date and COBRA notice + opt-in guidance (People Ops)

casey: @nina I can confirm the laptop serial is SN-RW-2345 and I have two personal SSH keys in my account (work@home and macbook-pro). I'll be available to handover notes all week.

omar: Got the serial. For keys/tokens, I'll run: 
```
# revoke personal deploy keys
gh api -X DELETE /user/keys/KEY_ID
# remove gcloud service account keys
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=sa@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
I'll also list org-level tokens and attach to the ticket.

leah: For VPN and shared secrets: rotate the team vault path after deprovision. Example: `vault kv delete secret/team/casey` then rotate `shared-api-key`. If anyone needs emergency access after cutover, open a short-lived support ticket.

it-ops-bot: New ticket created: IT-4821 — "Casey (last day 2026-06-04) access removal + laptop return". Assigned to Omar. ETA initial actions 1 business day. :white_check_mark:

nina: COBRA note: benefits coverage ends 2026-06-30 (end of month). People Ops will send COBRA packet on 2026-06-03 with opt-in instructions and contact for questions. Will add link to vendor portal and one-pager about timelines.

omar: Plan for staged deprovision: 
1) Disable SSO access at 9am on last day (preserve email for 24h)
2) Revoke personal keys/tokens at 10am
3) Remove from oncall rotations and alerting groups 10:15am
4) Rotate shared secrets 11am

nina: Shipping: Casey will drop laptop at the office reception on last day, or we'll send a prepaid label. I'll confirm preference Wednesday.

casey: I'll drop it at reception — thanks for the smooth process. Also, I'm happy to join a 30-min post-exit knowledge dump if helpful.

leah: One more ask: capture any 3rd-party SaaS admin rights (e.g., CI, analytics). If Casey is sole admin anywhere, we need immediate transfer before last day.

nina: Agreed. Please add any items you find to IT-4821. I'll send the exit interview invite and COBRA packet once the ticket has the full inventory. :rocket:
